engine_gaps: No locomotion: monsters never move in either simulation (world sim scatters statically; actor sim updates facing only, navigation explicitly deferred native/src/core.cpp:661-665). Engagement is therefore a pure proximity threshold.
No threat/aggro table, no leash/home position, no call-for-help: killing a pack member does not alter neighbours' behaviour; disengage at range 4 lets players trivially reset any fight.

Two engagement vocabularies coexist: actor-sim elites act unconditionally each tick within range bands (native/src/core.cpp:636-658) while world-sim monsters need adjacency plus per-monster next_attack_ms clocks (native/src/core.cpp:1844-1845,1951).

negative_tests: Deterministic pursuit replay: same seed + command script must yield identical monster positions every tick once locomotion exists.
Leash snap-back: monster pulled beyond aggro_radius from home must return and fully heal only if authored so - assert whatever rule is chosen is stable across replays.
No free damage: a player outside every monster's aggro_radius must receive zero incoming hit events over N ticks.
